Class ElectricalPower

java.lang.Object
sysmlinjava.common.SysMLAnything
sysmlinjava.attributetypes.SysMLAttributeType
sysmlinjava.attributetypes.ElectricalPower
All Implemented Interfaces:
ObservableAttribute, StackedProtocolObject
public class ElectricalPower extends SysMLAttributeType implements StackedProtocolObject
SysMLinJava value type for electrical power in terms of frequency, potential, and current. It can be used to represent power flows into electrical power sinks (computers, moters, other circuits) and out of electrical power sources (generators, batteries, etc.) or similar. The class also provides class-level constants for frequently used standard values of frequency, voltage, and current. The watts() method is provided to convert the attributes into power as watts.

ModelerOne

      Description copied from class: SysMLAttributeType

protected void createUnits()
